Hi @user-1, thanks, that was quick! The split is fine from my side.

One thing to watch out for: once `src/docpipe/api/routes/document_libraries.py` is touched, the ruff pre-commit hook flags every f-string `logger` call in that file (G004, AGENTS.md rule 7). #297 already converts all of them. So either:
- wait until #297 is merged and rebase, then ruff only sees your lines, or
- open your PR now and convert those logger calls as well; if yours lands first, I'll rebase #297 on top of it.

Either way works for me.
